C1772.title: WAF Misconfiguration in the Capital One Data Breach
C1772.summary: In the Capital One data breach, an attacker exploited a misconfigured ModSecurity WAF reverse proxy combined with a server-side request forgery vulnerability to bypass the firewall and access sensitive data stored in AWS S3 buckets, resulting in a large-scale data leak. The incident highlights how WAF misconfiguration can become a critical link in the attack chain.

references.title: A Systematic Analysis of the Capital One Data Breach
